name: plan-viewer
description: A local reading desk for Markdown daily plans, tasks, and the code they touch.

scripts.test: PLANNING_ROOT=fixtures/planning node --test --test-reporter=dot server.test.ts code-dashboard.test.ts search.test.js code-diff.test.js pr-notes.test.ts check-planning.test.ts config.test.js
scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
